name: Modr Fragment
summary: At Whelgar Excavation Site, Modr Fragment lies among the relics and loose earth of a raptor-overrun dig. The ancient Titan script on it is one of four missing pieces of the Goaz Stone.

sections.title: A Piece of the Goaz Stone
sections.body: Prospector Whelgar uncovered the Goaz Stone, a massive tablet marked with ancient Titan writing, at his Wetlands dig. Vicious raptors drove the Explorers' League from the site before they could finish their work. The translated inscription broke off at four gaps, hiding warnings of a divine plan and a doomed prophecy. Modr Fragment is one of the missing pieces, left among the relics and overturned soil when the diggers fled for their lives.

sections.title: Secrets Beneath the Earth
sections.body: Prospector Whelgar can restore the full inscription by joining Modr Fragment with the Ados, Golm, and Neru fragments. Its translated words tell of the dawn of the world and speak of 'Old Gods... Chained Beneath the Land.' The dig in the marshlands has uncovered traces of a struggle from the world's beginning, bound beneath the soil.

faq.answer: Modr Fragment is a shard of inscribed stone broken from the Goaz Stone, an ancient Titan relic Prospector Whelgar found at the Whelgar Excavation Site in the Wetlands.

faq.q: Who is looking for this fragment?
faq.answer: Prospector Whelgar, an archeologist of the Explorers' League, seeks the fragment to complete the tablet's missing text. He is stationed at the edge of the raptor-infested dig site.

faq.q: What happens when all four fragments are gathered?
aliases: what does the goaz stone say
faq.answer: Joining Modr Fragment with the Ados, Golm, and Neru fragments lets Prospector Whelgar restore the Goaz Stone. Its full Titan script speaks of 'Old Gods... Chained Beneath the Land.'
You can find Modr Fragment scattered across the Whelgar Excavation Site east of Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands. It lies in ancient relic pots or patches of loose dirt guarded by aggressive raptors.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know the Explorers' League seeks lost pieces like Modr Fragment to decipher Titan heritage and uncover the deep history of your kind.
As an Alliance traveler, you help Prospector Whelgar brave the overrun excavation and preserve invaluable historical research for Ironforge.
